bible.summary: Heaven's gate on clouds: golden wrought gate with curls between pearl pillars, radiant light, doves, layered clouds, a golden path to the gate, Saint Peter's lectern with the book, a quill and inkpot (and variants hell, garden of Eden, space, crossroads of souls): Saint Peter jokes.

variants.change: Red cave: stalactites, hanging chains, glowing cracks, lava falls and a lava lake at the back, flames along the walls, flying sparks, a boiling cauldron on a fire on the right, a pitchfork leaning on the left wall.

Lush garden: blue sky with a faint rainbow, snowy mountains, hills with trees, a waterfall and a stream, a deer on the hill, an apple tree with red apples and the serpent on a branch on the right, bushes and flowers on the left, a rabbit, butterflies, birds.

Space: starry sky with nebulae and the Milky Way, a spiral galaxy, a ringed planet with a moon, the Earth, a satellite, a shooting star; grey moon surface with craters and rocks, a small rocket on the left, footprints and a little flag.

Crossroads in the clouds: a pale road comes from the viewer to a fork at the back centre, where the judge of souls stands (judge) between golden scales on a cloud pedestal (left of him) and a golden lectern with the open book of souls, a quill and inkpot (right of him); behind him a signpost with two arrow boards without words: up-left a white board with a winged halo, down-right a dark red board with a flame; the left branch is a golden stairway climbing up to a small pearly gate of paradise on a cloud island in golden rays with doves (left-road at its foot), the right branch is dark cracked cobblestone going down into a fiery hole in the clouds with flames, smoke and sparks (right-road at its start); souls stand at center, front-left, front-center, front-right.

bible.prompt: pearly gates on fluffy clouds, soft sky, golden light
